name: DirectHireAI Copilot
description: Auto-fills job applications on ATS portals with your DirectHireAI résumé and details. You always click Submit — never automatic.

content_scripts.//: smartr.me is SmartRecruiters' APPLICATION domain â€” 'I'm interested' on a posting navigates there, so the dedicated script has to own it too or the application page gets nothing.

//: Broad match, self-gated. Employers on Greenhouse/Lever/etc. routinely
serve the application from their OWN careers domain via a script embed
Greenhouse companies redirect off greenhouse.io that way, so a host
allowlist can never cover them -- previously only databricks/stripe/okta
were hardcoded and everyone else silently got no extension at all.
unknown_ats.js bails in the first few statements unless the page shows an
ATS signal or this tab was armed from the Copilot Queue; it does no work
and loads no modules on ordinary pages.
exclude_matches lists every host handled by a DEDICATED script -- listing
the same file in two matching entries would inject it TWICE.

content_scripts.//: MAIN-world fill fallback (page_fill.js, 2026-08-13). Passive: the isolated content-script fill delegates to it only when a value is reverted by a strict React/Workday validator, by tagging the element + dispatching dhai:fill. Runs everywhere we might fill (dedicated ATS hosts + the unknown_ats catch-all), except our own app pages.
